mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 62 degrees and overcast at Badger Prairie County Park, with the feels-like temperature sitting at 63 degrees. If you are out tonight, keep an eye out for the ISS as it crosses the sky starting at 7:37 PM, moving from the west northwest near Cross Plains toward the northeast near Madison.

The city is launching an eighteen-month process to update the 2026 Comprehensive Plan, which guides our future growth in housing and transportation. Residents can stay informed and involved by visiting the Envision Verona project website. Additionally, residents are encouraged to sign up for the city's digital newsletter to stay updated on local projects and news.

Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness or participate in Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, and the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival kicks off this Friday.

In a report covering the past few weeks, officers noted that on September 5th, they discovered multiple vehicles across several streets with cheese slices on their windshields as part of a viral social media trend.
